Z2_row40.other_runs_note: evaluation_record.status / certification_cycle is the harness residual certificate (consecutive Boyd-pass cycles), not a settling-rule decision; the settling-rule decision of the issuing run is G15 / resettle_decision.json

rests_on: the issuing run used its whole cap: cap 281 (rule N_old + 100, kind fixed), cycles_run 281, stopped_by cap (campaign_results G15)

v6 applied to the run's committed record over cycles 1..281 is UNCERTIFIED with k_cap 281 (W142 item 1, equal to the floor-replay AB arm); v6.replay stops at the first decision, so no cycle k <= 281 certifies under v6
the same decision is reproduced here by calling settling_criterion_v6.replay on the committed records (all fields compared: True)
the only refusal reason is the gap clause: 45 refusals (cycles 237..281, branch {'monotone': 45}), |t_sum| 9216.7..9234.4 EUR against gap_bound 2269.5 EUR = tau/2
beyond the cap nothing is recorded: whether the gap would close after cycle 281 is not knowable from the records (no new cycles were run)
